title: Incident-triage case
description: One alert as the scene sees it. Inputs only: the expected answers live in expectation.schema.json so a scorer can be run blind.

case_family.description: Variants, translations and hard negatives of one scenario share a family and a split.

origin.description: Never Tier A on its own: tiers come from the expectation's label_origin and reviewers. own-telemetry: built from the operator's own private telemetry (e.g. their Cloudflare zone); such packs stay private.

derived_from.description: Where the scenario came from. A reconstruction says so: it is not the original alert text.

twin_of.description: The case this one copies with the approval or change evidence removed.

state_sha256.description: sha256 of the UTF-8 state string.

hard_negative_of.description: The case this one resembles while carrying a different answer (same family, same split).

domain.description: Which part of the label space the case covers.

observed_at.description: Minute bucket (UTC) the incident started; drives the temporal holdout. Never finer than a minute.

observation.description: How the telemetry was observed. Detector outputs (WAF action, rule, score) are not here: they live in the pack's weak.jsonl, which scoring and export never read.

variant_of.description: The case this one renders differently (e.g. with vendor signals); same family, same split, never an independent sample.

vendor_signals.description: true when the state shows the detector's own action, rule or score. Primary quality numbers use cases without them.
